reference: Original source centered-variance function independently compiled; GNU also compared bit-for-bit with the original shared-library function. Actual original GGML NORM graphs. No Rust output used.
floating_environment: nearest-even, gradual underflow, FTZ/DAZ disabled; status flag parity is outside this API contract.
notes: F32 centering and square products; SSE2 adjacent-pair F32 square reduction before F64 accumulation; individual tail squares.
Return is F64(sum)/n, and the NORM caller then casts variance to F32 before epsilon/sqrt and scales centered F32 values.
Native NORM input has contiguous inner rows with padding in higher strides; this does not assert the separate noncontiguous-inner-axis scalar F32 loop.
Zero-length primitive and nonfinite words are retained as observed native behavior; graph corpus is finite with positive epsilon.
